claims.claim: No prompt condition produced a replicable reduction in output tokens or cost against the baseline.
claims.val: P6 -26.9% then +3.4%; P4 paired 0.851 then 1.104. Both reversed.
claims.alt: An effect smaller than the noise floor could exist and be undetectable here.
claims.lim: 18 tasks, one corpus, one model, reasoning enabled, 3 runs.

claims.claim: Output-token variability under reasoning-enabled deepseek-flash is large: median within-task relative spread 44% for an identical condition and task.
claims.val: median 44%, mean 53%, max 171%; coefficient of variation 1.73 unpaired
claims.alt: Some spread may come from cache-boundary effects rather than decoding.

claims.claim: The control differed from itself by 13% in mean output tokens across two independent runs with no treatment applied.
Detecting a 20% effect on unpaired means in this design would need about 1,169 trials per arm.
claims.alt: A paired design needs far fewer.

claims.claim: Unpaired condition means are dominated by task mix: P6 read -26.9% unpaired and 1.020 paired on the same data.
claims.val: output tokens span 60 to 22,000+ across task classes

claims.claim: A cached-token count of 13,563 was observed, which is not a multiple of 128.
claims.val: P3/aggregation.const.mixed rep0: 13,563 cached + 134 fresh; its sibling rep 13,440 + 257, identical total input 13,697
claims.alt: Concurrency-specific behaviour; the 35 earlier rungs were sequential cold/warm pairs.

claims.claim: Conditions sharing leading suffix scaffolding cache one extra 128-token block (P6: 13,568 versus 13,440).
The cache confound is bounded at 128 tokens, about 4.3% of a mean trial's cost, and output is 82-85% of trial cost.
claims.val: $0.0000376 per trial against a mean trial of $0.0008721

claims.claim: Accuracy differences between conditions are not distinguishable from noise: only three of 18 tasks ever failed, scattered across prose and structured conditions.
claims.val: transform.reverse.funcname failed under P0, P1, P4, P5; counting.func.lines under P0, P3; counting.rawmessage under P1, P6
claims.alt: A real accuracy effect smaller than this noise could exist.

claims.claim: Whether any output reduction would come from less narration, less hidden reasoning, or a shorter answer.
Patent prior-art search for prompt optimization.
claims.lim: No novelty or freedom-to-operate conclusion available.
